Independent Limited Assurance Report to the Board of Directors of Vajra Steel & Power Ltd. We were engaged by Vajra Steel & Power Ltd (the Company) to perform a limited assurance engagement on the BRSR Core information for the year ended 31 March 2022 (the Subject Matter Information), as reported in its BRSR. The scope of our engagement covered BRSR Core: GHG, water and energy footprint, waste, employee safety and inclusive development KPIs.

Management is responsible for preparing the Subject Matter Information under the SEBI BRSR Core framework and for related internal controls. Our responsibility is to express a limited assurance conclusion. We performed the engagement in accordance with ISAE 3000 (Revised) and, for the attestation of controls over reported data, the principles of SSAE No. 21 issued by the AICPA, and complied with the applicable independence and quality control requirements.

A limited assurance engagement is substantially less in extent than a reasonable assurance engagement. Our procedures comprised inquiries of management, analytical procedures, a visit to Barbil Pellet Plant, and testing of a sample of supporting records. We reconciled reported Scope 1 emissions of 11,900,000 tCO2e and Scope 2 emissions of 1,440,000 tCO2e to the underlying calculation workbooks.

Conclusion: based on our procedures, nothing has come to our attention that causes us to believe that the Subject Matter Information for FY2021-22 is not prepared, in all material respects, in accordance with the BRSR Core framework.

Inherent limitations apply to non-financial data and emission estimates. This report is intended solely for the Board of Directors and for submission to the stock exchanges. Rao & Iyer Assurance LLP, Chartered Accountants.

Independent Limited Assurance Report to the Board of Directors of Kangra Minerals Ltd. We were engaged by Kangra Minerals Ltd (the Company) to perform a limited assurance engagement on the BRSR Core information for the year ended 31 March 2022 (the Subject Matter Information), as reported in its BRSR. The scope of our engagement covered BRSR Core: GHG footprint, energy, water, waste management and safety indicators.

Management is responsible for preparing the Subject Matter Information under the SEBI BRSR Core framework and for related internal controls. Our responsibility is to express a limited assurance conclusion. We performed the engagement in accordance with SAE 3000 and the ICAI Guidance Note on Reporting on BRSR Core, which are consistent with ISAE 3000 (Revised), and complied with the applicable independence and quality control requirements.

A limited assurance engagement is substantially less in extent than a reasonable assurance engagement. Our procedures comprised inquiries of management, analytical procedures, a visit to Dhenkanal Beneficiation Plant, and testing of a sample of supporting records. We reconciled reported Scope 1 emissions of 66,870 tCO2e and Scope 2 emissions of 25,286 tCO2e to the underlying calculation workbooks.

Conclusion: based on our procedures, nothing has come to our attention that causes us to believe that the Subject Matter Information for FY2021-22 is not prepared, in all material respects, in accordance with the BRSR Core framework.

Inherent limitations apply to non-financial data and emission estimates. This report is intended solely for the Board of Directors and for submission to the stock exchanges. Bhargava Menon & Associates, Chartered Accountants.

Independent Limited Assurance Report to the Board of Directors of Varuna Ores Ltd. We were engaged by Varuna Ores Ltd (the Company) to perform a limited assurance engagement on the BRSR Core information for the year ended 31 March 2023 (the Subject Matter Information), as reported in its BRSR. The scope of our engagement covered BRSR Core: GHG footprint, energy, water, waste management and safety indicators.

Management is responsible for preparing the Subject Matter Information under the SEBI BRSR Core framework and for related internal controls. Our responsibility is to express a limited assurance conclusion. We performed the engagement in accordance with ISAE 3000 (Revised), Assurance Engagements Other than Audits or Reviews of Historical Financial Information, and ISAE 3410, Assurance Engagements on Greenhouse Gas Statements, issued by the IAASB, and complied with the applicable independence and quality control requirements.

A limited assurance engagement is substantially less in extent than a reasonable assurance engagement. Our procedures comprised inquiries of management, analytical procedures, a visit to Giridih Coal Mine, and testing of a sample of supporting records. We reconciled reported Scope 1 emissions of 778,128 tCO2e and Scope 2 emissions of 370,314 tCO2e to the underlying calculation workbooks.

Conclusion: based on our procedures, nothing has come to our attention that causes us to believe that the Subject Matter Information for FY2022-23 is not prepared, in all material respects, in accordance with the BRSR Core framework.

Inherent limitations apply to non-financial data and emission estimates. This report is intended solely for the Board of Directors and for submission to the stock exchanges. Pillai Menon Sustainability LLP, Chartered Accountants.
